checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around dumbbell handles throughout the lift.
checks.feet: Torso remains supported by 45-degree bench, feet stable; shoulders elevate and retract slightly while both arms remain straight and hang down.
checks.movement: Chest supported on 45-degree incline bench with feet stationary. Dumbbells hang from straight arms. Elevate shoulders toward ears with slight retraction; pause and lower without elbow flexion or torso movement. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
